newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FNB prepares for July forex easing.
newsitem.headline: FNB prepares for July forex easing.

text.p: First National Bank Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was gearing itself to offer offshore banking services to clients when relaxation of exchange controls for individuals comes into effect July 1.
The South African Reserve Bank will announce the amount residents will be allowed to invest offshore later this month.

"The exact amount that South African residents will be able to transfer into other currencies...is likely to be between 100,000 and 250,000 rand, and we are tailoring our investment offerings accordingly," FNB's personal markets general manager Colin Minty said in a statement.
The bank will offer foreign currency accounts, Offshore Trusts for investment purposes, portfolio management and unit trusts.
Minty said the services would be operated by its merchant banking and offshore banking service unit Henry Ansbacher Group.
Ansbacher was founded in London in 1894 and was acquired in 1992 by FNB. It has been a strong performer for the group.
